item.title: Maintaining Integrity: South Africa's Strategic Focus in International Relations
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa and US President Donald Trump engaging on Afrikaner genocide misinformation during a meeting in the Oval Office of the White House, Washington DC on May 21, 2025.

item.title: Bystanders save two young girls in dramatic Millers Point Beach water rescue
item.description: NSRI rescue crews and emergency services responded to multiple incidents along the False Bay coastline over the festive weekend, including a beach rescue at Millers Point where two young children were saved by bystanders and treated on scene before being taken to hospital.

item.title: Bafana's Broos unfazed by quick AFCON turnaround ahead of must-win Zimbabwe clash
item.description: Bafana Bafana's Sphephelo Sithole fight for the ball with Egypt's Mahmoud Trezeguet during their Africa Cup of Nations Group B match.

item.title: Mob justice in Limpopo: Man beaten to death by community after he allegedly killed girlfriend
item.description: Police are investigating two murder cases and an attempted murder following a violent domestic incident that escalated into mob justice at Tjibeng Village in Limpopo.

item.title: North West arrests 36 motorists over festive weekend, reports 40% drop in fatalities
item.description: Ten motorists were arrested in the North West during the Christmas weekend for attempting to bribe law enforcement officers during intensified festive season roadblocks.

item.title: Investigation launched into EMS workers caught sleeping on duty in Nelson Mandela Bay
item.description: The Eastern Cape Department of Health has launched a probe after footage surfaced showing EMS workers apparently sleeping while on duty in Nelson Mandela Bay.

item.title: Myanmar junta stages election after five years of civil war
item.description: People line up to vote inside a polling station during the first phase of Myanmar's general election in Yangon on December 28, 2025. (Photo by NHAC NGUYEN / AFP)

item.title: Springboks highlights package for 2025 is endless but flogging of France takes the cake
item.description: Springbok captain Siya Kolisi is carried on the shoulders of locks Eben Etzebeth and RG Snyman after playing his 100th Test in their win over France in Paris.
